title: Unchecked None dereference on optional query result
diff:
@@ -1,5 +1,3 @@
 def get_customer_zipcode(db, customer_id: str) -> str:
     customer = db.find_customer(customer_id)
-    if not customer or not customer.address:
-        return "UNKNOWN"
     return customer.address.postal_code

ground_truth.description: Accessing customer.address without verifying that customer is not None causes AttributeError.
